requirements.requirement: Finish when the frozen method has independent validation, interpretable ablations, appropriate uncertainty estimates, documented failure modes, comparable resource evidence within the authorized shared-host scope, and a reproducible manuscript package. Resource completion requires the planned matched-resource panel and honest contention reporting, not an uncontended host or a claim of isolated performance. All other scientific and reproducibility requirements remain intact. Every major claim must link to supporting results. If the evidence does not support a claimed advantage, narrow the claim or explicitly identify the unmet scientific requirement; do not declare publication readiness solely because the analyses finished.
